title: AI Companies Are Trying to Hide a Staggering Amount of Debt
content: I don’t know about you, but every time I scroll through my news feed, I can't help but trip over yet another article about how AI companies are racking up an impressive pile of debt. It’s dizzying, right? I’ve been exploring this topic for a while now, and it's become clear there's a lot more than what meets the eye. title: From Idea to MVP in Weeks: How a Studio Compresses the Build
content: Most MVP timelines are not lost to writing features. They are lost to deciding things that did not need deciding, and to redoing setup that should have been standard.
